dominant_strengths: Calm sage blob is emotionally resonant; soft organic shape carries the 'calm' state more honestly than a generic emoji picker
Restrained palette and generous whitespace let the central form breathe, reinforcing the journaling intent
Clear hierarchy: question, date, blob, mood pills, input — reading order matches reflective task flow
dominant_weaknesses: Massive vertical void above the title makes the composition feel unanchored; canvas top-half is dead space
Mood pills are tiny dots with all-caps micro-labels — low tap affordance and label/dot ratio feels uncrafted
Input field and timestamp feel like a generic chat UI bolted onto a poetic visualization, breaking tonal unity
fix_priorities: Rebalance vertical rhythm — pull title down or enlarge blob so negative space frames rather than abandons the content
Redesign mood selector: larger swatches, sentence-case labels, or a single morphing chip to match the organic blob language
Integrate the text input into the blob's tonal world (borderless, larger type, ghost prompt) instead of a chat bar
Add a subtle breathing/morph motion cue to the blob so the static medium gains the elegance the brief implies
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral leads via the soft sage form, behavioral is adequate but tap targets are weak, and reflective lands moderately through the gentle prompt and date.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads as an emotion journal and the mood-as-shape metaphor fits, but execution stays at competent-template level rather than human-quality craft.
